title: One-Sixth Forecast v2: How thin materials burn at lunar gravity in Moon-base air
description: A cited dataset of NASA reduced-gravity fire tests, two flammability-limit models with held-out Earth checks, an independent review, and a timestamped forecast: at lunar gravity and habitat pressure (8.2 psia), thin cellulose tissue keeps burning down to 13.8-17.9% oxygen, most likely near 15.5%. Registered 15 November 2026, before any fire experiment has run on the Moon. NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, Flame in Freefall.
